resources.string: Gmail access uses the Google Android AuthorizationClient with the feature scopes you enable. A personal OAuth client is optional in Advanced.
Drive access uses the Google Android AuthorizationClient with the feature scopes you enable. A personal OAuth client is optional in Advanced.
Enable this feature to request its scope
Create your own Google OAuth client

1. Create a Google Cloud project that you own. 2. Enable Gmail API and Drive API. 3. Configure the OAuth consent screen as External, publish status Testing, and add your Google account under Test users. 4. Create an OAuth client of type Desktop app and paste its Client ID here. The client secret is optional for installed apps; if supplied, Jarvys stores your value encrypted on this device only. Do not paste anyone else’s client credentials.

Google permits loopback redirects for Desktop clients but marks loopback deprecated for mobile apps. This BYO Desktop flow may be rejected on Android or by Google; use only for your own testing. It is not a Play-approved mobile OAuth flow.
Configure the OAuth client you created in your own Google Cloud project.

Read mail and document text is included in this conversation and sent to your configured AI provider. Conversation history is stored locally. Requested downloads are saved as private native attachments in this chat; their raw binary bytes are not sent to the model. These contents are not automatically added to persistent memory.
Gmail read and labels · gmail.readonly · Restricted
Read, create, replace and send drafts · gmail.compose · Restricted
Send directly · gmail.send · Sensitive · disabled by default · approval required
Search, metadata and read/export · drive.readonly · Restricted
Create and update app-authorized files · drive.file · Per-file access
Disconnect Gmail and Drive in Jarvys and stop pending authorization. This does not revoke the grant in your Google account. You can revoke Google access separately in Advanced.

Direct send is off by default. Each message requires an approval card; Allow is limited to recipients you typed, a sender listed in this run, or a saved contact. Otherwise the action stays in Ask mode.
The selected Google feature is authorized.
Authorization could not be completed. Retry from this screen or check Android OAuth configuration in Advanced.
Google Play services is unavailable or needs an update on this device. Use your own OAuth client under Advanced, or install/update Google Play services.
Google authorization was cancelled. Existing granted features are unchanged unless you disconnected.
Google did not grant the requested feature permission. Enable it again to retry.
Google authorization could not reach Google. Check your connection and retry.
Google may require app verification or restrict consent to eligible test users. Review the app identity and requested permissions. Jarvys cannot verify or change these Google project settings.
Google issues short-lived access tokens, kept only in memory by Jarvys. API calls cannot request new consent automatically; authorize additional features explicitly from this screen.
Google rejected the redirect URI. Check that your Desktop OAuth client has the exact loopback callback configured and allows this account.

Google rejected the app or account configuration. Check the Android OAuth package and signing SHA-1, enabled APIs, consent settings and any required test-user access. The exact Console setting has not been verified.
Google did not return to Jarvys. Return to the app and try the sign-in again.
Search with Gmail query syntax, up to 25 results per page and an explicit continuation token.
Return headers and bounded plain text; attachments are metadata only.
Create a draft after approval; it is not sent.
Always requires the write approval card; delivery is not assumed.
Search names and full text with parent, MIME and shared-drive filters; up to 25 files per page.
Read text files or export Docs, Sheets, Slides to text or CSV; maximum 1 MiB.
Create a text file or upload a current-chat attachment after approval; multipart request maximum 5 MiB.
There is no current user-message context; confirm this email action manually.
Some recipients were not typed by you, listed as a sender this run, or found in your contacts; confirm this email action.
Disconnected in Jarvys. Google account access has not been revoked.

Google revocation affects every scope granted to this app for the selected account. Jarvys will disconnect locally now and report whether Google confirms revocation. A network failure can leave the Google grant active.
Disconnected locally. Waiting for Google to confirm revocation…
Google confirmed that access was revoked.
Disconnected locally, but Google revocation was not confirmed. Review third-party access in your Google account before retrying.

The Google Cloud project must have Gmail API and Drive API enabled, an Android OAuth client matching this installed package and signing certificate, and an eligible consent audience. A personal Desktop client is not needed for the integrated Android flow. Jarvys cannot verify these Console settings from this screen.
No installed signing certificate is available in this environment.
Google access was disabled locally for both Gmail and Drive. Account access was not revoked.

This removes the saved local credential needed to retry the failed revocation. It does not revoke Google access. First review this app in your Google account. Google access may remain active; Jarvys will not mark it as revoked.
A previous Google revocation is unresolved. Retry revocation, or review Google account access before forgetting the local retry credential.
